dimensions.assessment: Affects official references to a single physical bandstand in the U.S. Virgin Islands.
dimensions.evidence: The bandstand commonly referred to as the Christiansted Bandstand... is designated as the Peter G. Thurland, Sr., Bandstand

dimensions.assessment: Purely ceremonial designation with no administrative or substantive policy changes.
No federal spending or revenue effects are mentioned.
Applies to legal and administrative references for one specific structure.
dimensions.evidence: Any reference in any law, regulation, document, record, map, or other paper... is deemed to be a reference

importance_detail.rationale: This bill designates a specific bandstand at the Christiansted National Historic Site in the U.S. Virgin Islands with a commemorative name.
